answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 75 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a pigment bet on surviving 75 epochs of grading, and every walnut settlement recomputes the marble schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
